Variants.Content: The town of Selhorys is located between Volantis and the lower reaches of the Rhoyne rivers, and is politically within the city-state of Volantis and its system of rivers, roads and affiliated towns. It is a town, a center where surrounding populations, markets, roads and local power converge. Walls and roads tied the surrounding population, storage, and garrison here; even if the flags were changed, this stronghold would still affect how nearby people paid taxes, traded, and sought refuge.

Entry Selhorys Local families also relied on river transportation, slave labor, elephant caravans, Changqiao Market, and seagoing ships from the south; if any road, well, spring, or wharf failed, the price would fall on them first.

Entry Selhorys They will also recognize the accents, laws and credentials of the Volantis and the Lower Rhoyne; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, and real distances must still be measured by wheel, oar or horse's hoof.

Entry Selhorys If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.
Entry Selhorys A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Selhorys They care about river transportation, slave labor, elephant teams, Changqiao Market, and seagoing ships from the south. They also look at whether seeds are left after the grain collection and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
